identityStatus: The Open Buildings envelope at the temple identity supplies roof widths and orientation. The documented Tam Bảo plan links the covered front hall with the deeper central shrine.

terrainContact.basis: Original Copernicus profile at the northeastern frontage. Projected foundations bind the hall to the elevated courtyard.

notes: Hoàng Việt’s native public-domain photograph shows the low tile eaves and raised gabled story, upturned eave tips and dark timber front with red columns. The current temple account dates the rebuilding.
